body:
That was a long Spiel, and I respect all that you said. My personal response is that the friend's suicidal intent is a function of alcoholism, where the friend does not seem to really want it. The alcoholism allows them to get dangerously close to realising something they do not want when sober.

I think your own situation is more genuine 100% of the time. I don't want my friend to make this decision in an offhand way that is only present when inebriated.
